title: ZenChad charging and unplugged voice catalogue

samples.title: Overnight — sleep well
samples.text: [softly] You’ve made it through another day. Sleep well, little starlight.

samples.title: Overnight — rest easy
samples.text: [reassuringly] The world can keep turning without you for a while. Rest easy tonight.

samples.title: Overnight — moonlit watch
samples.text: [warmly] Let the moon keep watch for a bit. Sleep well, and drift gently.

samples.title: Morning — friendly possibilities
samples.text: [brightly] Good morning, little sunrise. May your day unfold like a sky full of friendly possibilities.

samples.title: Morning — pockets of wonder
samples.text: [warmly] Good morning. The day is waiting with its pockets full of small wonders.

samples.title: Morning — room for wonder
samples.text: [cheerfully] Morning, starlight. Take a breath, stretch into the day, and let something lovely surprise you.

samples.title: Afternoon — brighter than expected
samples.text: [warmly] Have a wonderful afternoon. May the rest of your day glow a little brighter than expected.

samples.title: Afternoon — tiny adventures
samples.text: [lightly] Enjoy your afternoon. There are still plenty of tiny adventures hiding in the hours ahead.

samples.title: Afternoon — doing better
samples.text: [reassuringly] Have a beautiful afternoon. You’re doing better than the clock makes it seem.

samples.title: Evening — enchanting constellation
samples.text: [softly] Have an enchanting evening. Let the day fold itself into a little constellation of memories.

samples.title: Evening — lights coming on
samples.text: [warmly] Have a lovely evening. May the lights come on gently, one by one, wherever you go.

samples.title: Evening — leave room for wonder
samples.text: [dreamily] Enjoy the evening, starlight. Leave a little room for wonder before the night arrives.

samples.title: Charging thanks — relieved
samples.text: [relieved] Oh, thank you for charging me. I was running on fumes down here.

samples.title: Charging thanks — grateful top-up
samples.text: [gratefully] Thank you for the top-up. That gives me a little more sparkle for the journey.

samples.title: Charging thanks — powered up
samples.text: [warmly] Thank you for charging me. I’m feeling nicely powered up again.

samples.title: Charging thanks — delighted surprise
samples.text: [surprised, pleased] Oh! You charged me all the way? Thank you. That’s wonderfully excessive.
